blocks.text: Open Files from Waybar or the desktop menu. Thunar handles ordinary file operations, removable media and archive integration. Use the location bar to enter a path; hidden configuration files can be shown with Ctrl+H.

The account's Sharing folder exposes only configured mounts. An empty disconnected mount directory is not permission to create a local replacement. Use Network Sharing or Drives & Backups to connect/disconnect the owned resource.

Check Trash before restoring from backup. Confirm source and destination for copy/move operations. Close open documents before ejecting storage. Do not start the file manager as root to bypass an ownership issue.
Deletion on remote filesystems, permanent deletion and overwriting may bypass Trash. Keep independent backups.
